about: Secret-scanner rule data shared by the ledger (src/secrets.mjs, Node) and the latent runtime's gateway (runtime/latent_team/secret_scan.py, Python): cards P4b, P4c and W2. Both read this file, so a rule changes in one place; rules/secret-conformance.json holds the cases both test suites run against each side's scanner. Patterns are written for JavaScript's u flag; the Python side rewrites each one so it matches the same text (JavaScript's word characters and whitespace, and its case folding spelled out letter by letter), and matches the anchored ones whole. Offsets in the conformance cases count code points.

simple.about: A pattern that recognises where a value starts, the class of characters the value then runs on (null: none), an anchored pattern whose match is the public prefix that may be shown, and optionally mixedAfter: the value from that index on must hold a letter and a digit.

values.about: A value after a name: the lead (case-insensitive) ends where the value begins; the value runs on cls, or to its closing quote, and must match accept.

jwt.about: A JSON Web Token: a header that start finds, a dot, a payload that opens with segment and holds at least payloadMin base64url characters, a dot, and a signature that may be empty. Its first prefix characters may be shown.

privateKey.about: A private key block, walked line by line: the begin line (its first group is the label), header lines that match header and one blank line after them, body lines, and the end line of the same label ({label} is replaced by the label).

freeText.about: Card P4c: after one of these leads (case-insensitive) the rest of the line is the value. The assigned-secret lead is assignedLead with {keywords} replaced by nameKeywords joined by |.

placeholders.about: A free-text value that is only a stand-in for a secret, judged on the whole value. A value longer than maxJudged characters is judged once all the leads on its line are known (a value that holds another assignment is never a stand-in), so judging stays linear; a value collected from a finding that is longer than maxJudged is kept as a value without being judged. flags i is case-insensitive. An angle-bracket value is a stand-in when it matches angleStandIn and one of its words (split by spaces, underscores or hyphens) is in standInWords.
